shortDescription: List and filter on Image Share Groups.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Image Share Groups to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Image Share Groups.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Specifies the private image ID to list share groups for. If provided, only share groups containing the specified image will be returned.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Image Share Groups in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Image Share Groups by.
